description: This PHP class defines a client for interacting with the Amazon SageMaker Service via AWS SDK for PHP. It extends the AwsClient class and includes numerous method annotations for various SageMaker API operations, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous calls.

classes.name: SageMakerClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon SageMaker Service, providing methods for a wide range of SageMaker operations, both synchronous and asynchronous.

methods.name: addAssociation
methods.description: Adds an association between SageMaker resources.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Adds tags to a SageMaker resource.

methods.name: associateTrialComponent
methods.description: Associates a trial component with a trial.

methods.name: batchDeleteClusterNodes
methods.description: Deletes multiple cluster nodes in a batch.

methods.name: createEndpoint
methods.description: Creates an endpoint for real-time inference.
